dict.string: MSG analyzes the system audio output so the now-playing visualizer bars react to the actual sound.
MSG needs to check Music.app playback state to show now-playing track in the menu bar.
macOS only shares Wi-Fi network names with apps that have Location access. MSG uses it to list networks in its Wi-Fi menu.
